kings.name: Ur-Nanshe
kings.title: King of Lagash
kings.description: Founder of the First Dynasty of Lagash; built temples and traded with Dilmun.

kings.name: Enmetena
kings.title: King of Lagash
kings.description: Ruler of Lagash who defeated Umma and restored the border channel.

kings.name: Lumma
kings.title: King of Umma
kings.description: King of Umma during the border wars with Lagash; raided the Gu-Edinna.

kings.name: Sargon of Akkad
kings.title: King of Akkad
kings.description: Founder of the Akkadian Empire; first ruler to unite Sumer and Akkad under one state.

kings.name: Rimush
kings.title: King of Akkad
kings.description: Son of Sargon; spent his reign suppressing revolts and campaigning in Elam.

kings.name: Manishtushu
kings.title: King of Akkad
kings.description: Son of Sargon; campaigned across the Lower Sea and carried out land reform.

kings.name: Naram-Sin
kings.title: King of Akkad
kings.description: Grandson of Sargon; first Mesopotamian king to claim divinity; campaigned in the Zagros and Syria.

kings.name: Shar-Kali-Sharri
kings.title: King of Akkad
kings.description: Son of Naram-Sin; defended Akkad against Gutian and Amorite incursions.
kings.source: Shar-Kali-Sharri year names; Sumerian King List

kings.name: Erridupizir
kings.title: King of Gutium
kings.description: Gutian ruler who left royal inscriptions at Nippur during the Gutian domination of Sumer.

kings.name: Shulgi
kings.title: King of Ur
kings.description: Second king of the Third Dynasty of Ur; conqueror of Susa and author of wide-ranging administrative reforms.

kings.name: Amar-Suen
kings.title: King of Ur
kings.description: Third king of Ur III; campaigned in the Zagros against Urbilum and neighbouring lands.

kings.name: Ibbi-Suen
kings.title: King of Ur
kings.description: Last king of the Third Dynasty of Ur; lost the provinces to Ishbi-Erra and was taken captive to Elam.
kings.source: Ibbi-Suen year names; Sumerian King List

events.name: Ur-Nanshe Founds the First Dynasty of Lagash
events.description: Ur-Nanshe establishes Lagash as a major city-state, building temples and opening trade with Dilmun.

events.name: Lumma of Umma Raids the Gu-Edinna
events.description: The king of Umma encroaches on the fertile Gu-Edinna plain claimed by Lagash, reigniting the border conflict.

events.name: Enmetena Defeats Umma and Restores the Border
events.description: Enmetena of Lagash routs Umma, rebuilds the boundary channel of the earlier treaty with Mesilim, and sets up new border markers.

events.name: The Revolt of Kish Against Sargon
events.description: Sargon crushes an uprising at Kish led by Iphur-Kishi, cementing his control over northern Sumer.
events.source: Sargon inscriptions (Old Babylonian copies); Sumerian King List

events.name: Sargon Extends His Empire to the Persian Gulf
events.description: Sargon campaigns against Ur and the southern cities, washing his weapons in the Persian Gulf as a mark of total conquest.

events.name: Rimush's Campaign Against Elam and Marhashi
events.description: Rimush defeats an Elamite-led coalition and campaigns against Marhashi, bringing eastern booty back to Akkad.

events.name: Manishtushu's Campaign Across the Lower Sea
events.description: Manishtushu leads a campaign across the Persian Gulf, defeating a coalition of thirty-two cities.

events.name: Naram-Sin's Campaign Against Magan
events.description: Naram-Sin campaigns against Magan (Oman) and its ruler Manium, extending Akkadian power to the Gulf trade routes.
events.source: Naram-Sin year names; inscribed objects from Ur

events.name: Shar-Kali-Sharri's Wars Against the Amorites
events.description: Shar-Kali-Sharri campaigns repeatedly against encroaching Amorite and Gutian groups in the late Akkadian period.
events.source: Shar-Kali-Sharri year names; Sumerian King List

events.name: Erridupizir Leaves Royal Inscriptions at Nippur
events.description: The Gutian king Erridupizir places inscriptions in the Ekur at Nippur, styling himself king of Gutium and of the four quarters.

events.name: Death of Ur-Namma on Campaign
events.description: Ur-Namma, founder of the Third Dynasty of Ur, dies in battle against the Gutians; his body is abandoned on the field.

events.name: Shulgi's Conquest of Susa and the Eastern Marches
events.description: Shulgi annexes Susa and the eastern highlands, installing governors and tying Elam into the Ur III state.

events.name: Amar-Suen's Campaign Against Urbilum
events.description: Amar-Suen leads a punitive campaign in the Zagros against Urbilum (Erbil) and its allies.

events.name: The Fall of the Ur III Empire
events.description: Ur is sacked by the Elamites and Ibbi-Suen is taken captive, ending the Third Dynasty of Ur and ushering in the Isin-Larsa period.
events.source: Sumerian King List; Lamentation over the Destruction of Ur

events.name: Ishbi-Erra's Campaign Against Kazallu
events.description: From his base at Isin, Ishbi-Erra destroys the rival city Kazallu, consolidating control of the south after Ur's fall.
